messages:
erin: Quick sync — planning to flip two flags tomorrow morning (US morning): reduce default retention to 30d for dev accounts, and enable security.audit_mode_v2 for a 5% enterprise canary. Need QA + ops checklist and a KMS/HSM fallback confirmation. :wave:
bob: Ack. Can we scope the audit_mode canary to just region=us-east-1 + customer_tier=enterprise? That keeps blast radius small. :eyes:
carla: Yes to region + tier. Also want logging.pii_redaction_level=high toggled at the same time for those users. Otherwise audit logs may contain PHI.
alex: Ops checklist: ensure KMS primary key available in us-east-1 and HSM fallback path tested. I can run the HSM failover test in staging today.
maya: Compliance: 30d dev retention is fine. For enterprise customers we still need a retention override option (enterprise retention policy separate). We'll document that.
erin: Proposed rollout plan (concise):
```
- time: 09:30 PT
- flag: security.audit_mode_v2 -> ON for 5% where region=us-east-1 AND customer_tier=enterprise
- flag: logging.pii_redaction_level -> high for the same scope
- retention.default_days -> 30 for accounts with tag:env=dev
- kms.primary -> aws-kms-us-east-1
- kms.fallback -> hsm-cluster-01 (only on failure)
- monitoring: alert if audit logs contain unredacted_pii > 0 for canary scope
- rollback: flip flags OFF, restore retention, open incident channel
```
carla: Quick config note: make sure KV cache for audit_mode is invalidated after toggle (we saw stale policy reads last time). Add cache-bust step.
bob: Code review ping: I posted small PR to toggle-checker that enforces the canary percentage and scope. @carla can you review? PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/feature-flags/pulls/432
carla: On it, will review in next 30m.
deploy-bot: Flag rollout scheduled by erin at 2025-11-30T17:30:00Z for environment=prod (dry-run false). :rocket:
alex: Staging HSM failover test result: PASSED. Keys re-wrapped by HSM and requests succeeded. Logs: `hsm://rekey/ok`
maya: One doc ask: we need to update the enterprise onboarding doc to call out audit_mode implications (SLA, logs retention, support process). I'll draft a short section.
erin: Thanks. Two quick safety guardrails — can we add auto-fallback to audit_mode_v1 if audit_mode_v2 throws >5% error rate for 10m? And an automatic rollback if unredacted_pii count > 0 for 5m?
carla: Yep, will add the SLO-based fallback rule. Also will add a circuit-breaker in the feature gate.
bob: After carla's review I'll merge the PR and schedule the toggle window. Ops will be on-call.
alex: Ops runbook quick checklist (to confirm during rollout):
1) Confirm KMS primary key health (kms-cli status)
2) Confirm HSM cluster connectivity
3) Ensure cache-bust API call queued
4) Watch logs for `unredacted_pii` metric
5) Verify retention config applies to dev accounts
erin: Can we get a volunteer to own post-rollout verification (5-15m checks)? Need someone to watch alerts and confirm no customer-facing errors.
bob: I can own post-rollout verification. Will be available 09:25-10:30 PT.
maya: I'll do compliance verification and sign-off if logs show no raw-PII exposure.
carla: PR LGTM, added cache-bust and fallback rule. Merge when ready.
deploy-bot: Flag security.audit_mode_v2 set to ON for scope {region:us-east-1, customer_tier:enterprise, pct:5} in prod at 2025-11-30T17:31:12Z (initiated by bob).
erin: Rolling now. Watching metrics dashboard. :eyes:
bob: Post-rollout quick update (09:35 PT): audit_mode_v2 active, no errors, unredacted_pii metric = 0, latency +2ms median.
alex: KMS/HSM metrics look normal, failover not triggered.
maya: Compliance sign-off: sampling logs — no unredacted PII seen. ✅
carla: Good. We'll keep canary for 24h then increase to 20% if stable.
erin: Thanks team — I'll update the rollout tracking doc and schedule the next ramp in #eng-release. :thumbsup:
bob: One follow-up: add a monitoring alert for retention drift (if retention.default_days != configured for dev accounts). I can add that rule next sprint.
erin: Great — closing thread after we ramp. If any regression, re-open or ping #incidents.
